subject: Next steps: SOC 2 Type II report access, GDPR/HIPAA scope & DSQ kickoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@greenline.health>, procurement@greenline.health
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-15T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps: SOC 2 Type II report access, GDPR/HIPAA scope & DSQ kickoff

Hi Elena / GreenLine team —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today — appreciate the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

1) Security artifacts we can share: SOC 2 Type II report (2026), an attestation letter, and a pre-filled vendor security questionnaire (DSQ) to speed your intake.
2) Compliance scope questions from your side: HIPAA / BAA requirement, GDPR data residency and processor obligations. Please confirm the primary security/legal contact for those items.
3) Timeline: looks like procurement aims to finalize by end of September. If you can share any internal deadlines or gating items (e.g., legal review windows), we’ll prioritize accordingly.

Proposed immediate actions (I can own coordination):
- I’ll share SOC 2 Type II PDF + attestation and invite you to our Trust Portal for granular artifacts.
- Monica (CS) will provision portal access and upload the DSQ prefill.
- Neha (security) will review your questions around HIPAA/BAA and GDPR and draft a short scoping note for legal.

Please confirm the contact for legal/procurement and whether a portal invite + DocuSign BAA is acceptable approach.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
[Attachment: none yet]

From: Elena Rodriguez <elena@greenline.health>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16T11:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SOC 2 Type II report access, GDPR/HIPAA scope & DSQ kickoff

Thanks Ben — great session. Quick answers and asks from our side: 

- Primary security contact for GreenLine: Mark Johnson (mark.johnson@greenline.health) and legal/procurement is procurement@greenline.health.
- We do require HIPAA controls and a signed BAA before any PHI is processed. Please confirm Redwood’s support model (do you sign BAAs, and is ePHI processed in a HIPAA-compliant mode?).
- GDPR: our legal team needs a DPA that confirms processor obligations; we also need to confirm whether data can be kept in US-only regions.
- Could you please share your most recent SOC 2 Type II report and any accompanying attestation/cover letter? We also prefer to work from a pre-filled DSQ — please attach if possible.

Procurement timeline: we intend to complete vendor security review within 3 weeks of receiving the report/BAA/DPA. I’ve attached our intake workbook so you can see the fields our procurement team will use.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Rodriguez
Senior IT Security Manager, GreenLine Health
[Attachment: GLH_security_requirements_v1.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: GreenLine security intake — action items (SOC2, BAA, DSQ)

Monica / Neha — forwarding GreenLine’s asks (attachment). High level asks: SOC2 Type II PDF + attestation, portal invite, prefilled DSQ, DPA/BAA confirmation and regional residency note.

Actions: 
- Monica: can you provision a Trust Portal invite for elena@greenline.health and procurement@greenline.health, upload the latest SOC2 PDF and an attestation letter, and drop the prefiller (redwood-dsq-prefill.xlsx)? Please mark which artifacts are public vs. restricted and share ETA.
- Neha: can you confirm HIPAA posture and BAA process (we do sign BAAs; please draft the standard BAA + short note on ePHI processing safeguards and US-only hosting options)? Also prepare a two-paragraph GDPR/DPA summary for legal.

Internal attachments: security-evidence-playbook.docx (internal checklist for portal handoff). Please respond with estimated ETA; client expects to complete review within ~3 weeks of receiving documents. If we can get portal/outbound docs by EOD 8/18 that would keep them on track.

Thanks — I’ll follow up to the client once I have the portal link and drafts.

Ben
Enterprise Lead
[Attachment: security-evidence-playbook.docx (internal guidance)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena@greenline.health>, procurement@greenline.health
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: SOC 2 Type II report access, GDPR/HIPAA scope & DSQ kickoff — portal invite + artifacts attached

Elena / team — following up with the items we discussed. 

What I shared: 
- SOC 2 Type II report (redwood-soc2-typeii-2026.pdf) [Attachment]
- Signed attestation letter (redwood-attestation-2027.pdf) [Attachment]
- Prefilled DSQ (redwood-dsq-prefill.xlsx) — we filled the standard GLH fields to speed your intake [Attachment]
- Trust Portal invite: https://redwood.trustportal.example.com/invite/GLH-2027 (use your corporate email to sign in; contact monica.patel@redwood.ai if you hit an SSO issue)
- BAA / DPA: We do sign BAAs. DocuSign BAA request link: https://docusign.com/BAA/GLH-2027. Neha has included a short HIPAA/GDPR summary in the portal (see "Compliance Overview" folder).

Quick notes on HIPAA/GDPR: 
- HIPAA / BAA: Redwood will be a Business Associate if contractually agreed; we process ePHI with encryption at rest/in transit, restricted access, and audit logging.
- GDPR / DPA: We offer a DPA with standard SCCs; we can restrict processing to US-only regions for your account if required — Monica will include the residency flag in the provisioning step.

Attachments (also uploaded to the portal): redwood-soc2-typeii-2026.pdf, redwood-attestation-2027.pdf, redwood-dsq-prefill.xlsx.

Next steps for GreenLine: 
- Please confirm receipt and whether portal access works (test sign-in by 8/19).
- If BAA is required, please sign via the DocuSign link; we’ll countersign within 48 hours.
- If you want a short technical call for HIPAA scoping, happy to book; propose 30 minutes next week.

If anything else is needed to keep procurement moving, tell me and I’ll escalate internally.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
[Attachments: redwood-soc2-typeii-2026.pdf (pdf), redwood-attestation-2027.pdf (pdf), redwood-dsq-prefill.xlsx (xlsx)]
